name: PT Bank Amar Indonesia Tbk
summary: PT Bank Amar Indonesia Tbk provides banking products and services in Indonesia. The company operates through Online, Brick and mortar, and Head Office segments. Its deposit products include demand, saving, and time deposit; certificate of deposit; and other form of deposits, including deposit from other banks. The company also offers working capital loans and investment loans, such as installment, fixed, demand, and stand by; consumer loans, such as multi-purpose loans; housing, consumer, and third-party loans; and debit cards.
